topics.title: Repair dropped team membership links at boot and on edit

entries.title: Repair dropped team membership links at boot and on edit
entries.rationale: Accepted as a membership-integrity repair. Preserve authoritative team ownership, prior-to-current delta propagation, idempotent boot/edit repair, migration ordering, and fail-closed behavior around stale or missing links.
security_reasons: team membership controls managed-agent access and routing
boot repair must not widen membership from stale local state
membership deltas propagate into agent records and relay events
migration and event-sync ordering can affect authorization state

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated team-membership authorization review, migration/idempotence tests, event-signing and propagation checks, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, team/membership propagation, boot/edit repair, migration tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
